You accept it once, on your first pull request, and it covers every contribution you make to Tiles after that.

"You" means the individual who accepts this agreement.

"Contribution" means any work of authorship, code, documentation, design or other material that you submit to us for inclusion in Tiles, in a pull request, an issue, a comment or any other channel we use to discuss or change Tiles. Something you mark "Not a Contribution" when you submit it is not a Contribution.
